title: Wolf and Steampunk Girl
description: A large green wolf with glowing orange eyes and red liquid dripping from its muzzle dominates the left foreground. To the right, a young woman with long flowing brown hair, steampunk goggles, and a green cape stands on an ornate metal balcony attached to a massive industrial structure featuring a giant central green eye and multiple smokestacks.
prompt: A massive green wolf with glowing orange eyes and red liquid dripping from its jaws stands in the foreground, beside a steampunk girl with long flowing brown hair, aviator goggles, and green cape standing on an ornate balcony. Behind them is a colossal circular industrial machine with a giant glowing green mechanical eye at its center and multiple smokestacks emitting smoke into a stormy sky, dramatic fantasy painting
